subject.title: [Feature]: Make Skill Workshop extensible for custom skill creation workflows

question: Should OpenClaw support a first-class skill-creation authority/routing API, or should custom skill-creation workflows stay as plugin tools/skills that prepare proposal_content before using the existing skill_workshop primitive?
rationale: The current code has generic plugin tools, prompt hooks, before_tool_call policy, and Skill Workshop proposal persistence, but none of those expresses a pre-selection authority for skill creation; choosing that contract changes plugin API and tool-routing semantics.

options.title: Add a narrow authority seam
options.body: Create a generic, documented hook or policy layer for skill-creation routing while preserving skill_workshop as the only persistence/apply tool.

options.title: Use existing plugin/tool policy only
options.body: Document custom workflows as plugin tools or skills that prepare proposal_content and rely on operator tool policy or prompt guidance instead of adding a new API.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Keep this issue open as product backlog until maintainers decide whether this is core plugin API scope or a ClawHub workflow convention.

recommendation.title: Add a narrow authority seam
recommendation.body: Create a generic, documented hook or policy layer for skill-creation routing while preserving skill_workshop as the only persistence/apply tool.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the clearest current-main owner signal for the central Skill Workshop prompt/tool/service files in this checkout.
